category: Italian multi-hoster debrid with a 24-host list

free_tier.stated: None. The home page sells only a chat promo: 'CHAT PROMO: 365 DAYS - 21,90 euro', payable by credit card through WhatsApp or by Paysafecard/Bitcoin on request.

per_object_cap.stated: not stated: no per-file ceiling is published

retention.stated: generated links are valid for 72 hours from generation; nothing is stored

egress.terms: Vendor claims 'unlimited parallel downloads without waiting time'; the status page publishes a daily bandwidth figure for each host and no overall byte allowance. Server-side counter: 'Bandwidth consumption: 46,465.05 TB' across 4 servers.

interface_detail: Web application with a Telegram channel (@debriditalia) for announcements; no API, CLI or protocol endpoint is published on the reachable pages.
tooling: A web downloader page and download managers: the news page names JDownloader as a download manager that works with the service, and the FAQ says the generated link can be used from any download manager software; the Telegram channel carries announcements rather than a bot interface.
chaining: At EUR 1.83-1.96 per month of prepaid access it is the cheapest way to cover 24 European hosts, and it composes with JDownloader only insofar as the generated link is a plain HTTPS URL.

limits.value: per-host daily bandwidth on the status page, for example 1fichier.com 30.00 GB, ddownload.com 15.00 GB, alfafile.net 10.00 GB, hotlink.cc 3.50 GB and 4shared.com 50.00 GB; the news page calls the figure per user per day; no overall byte allowance is published

limits_note: The status page lists a daily bandwidth figure for each of the 24 hosts, from 3.50 GB (hotlink.cc) to 50.00 GB (4shared.com); the news page describes such a figure as per user per day ('6.00 GB al giorno per utente'). The home page claims 'unlimited parallel downloads'; no fair-use paragraph and no concurrency figure is published.
binding_note: The binding limit is the per-host daily bandwidth on the status page, from 3.50 GB (hotlink.cc) to 50.00 GB (4shared.com), described by the news page as per user per day; no overall allowance, request rate, per-object cap or concurrency figure is published.

identity_cost.detail: Registration is required to buy; the signup form was not opened. The promo is transacted over WhatsApp, which is the only channel the vendor names for payment questions.

reliability_note: Four servers and an Italian company number (P.I. 02707310807) behind it; payment for the annual promo runs through a WhatsApp chat rather than a card form, so a failed payment has no self-service path.
confidence_note: The status page, the FAQ price list and the home page statistics are vendor pages read on 2026-11-03; a reseller page lists a different 30-day price. Identity is unverified: no signup page was found and the annual promo is paid through a chat.

price_per_tb_month: EUR 3,9 per 30 days on the vendor FAQ price list (a reseller page lists EUR 4,50); EUR 1,83 per month at the vendor's EUR 21,90 / 365-day chat promo
notes: This is the cheapest effective monthly price and it appears in none of the English comparison sites; the reason is language plus payment: the annual deal is sold in an Italian WhatsApp chat, not through a checkout. The 24-host list is roughly a third of AllDebrid's, so the low price buys fewer hosts rather than cheaper bytes. Two price routes disagree (vendor EUR 21.90/year vs reseller EUR 23.90/year); the conservative number is recorded in price_per_tb_month.
